readerCopy.headline: Pleasure is easier to find, and easier to overdo.
readerCopy.body:
The social calendar can fill by itself. Someone you enjoy wants more time with you. A purchase makes the room better. A creative project gets more love than you expected. Money and affection can both move more easily because you are more willing to say yes to what feels good.

Jupiter conjunct Venus makes generosity easy and moderation less interesting. Enjoy the good part. Check the bill before the mood does the buying, and check the calendar before every pleasant invitation becomes a night you no longer have free.
